newsitem.title: USA: President Casinos chairman approached about land.
newsitem.headline: President Casinos chairman approached about land.

text.p: President Casinos Inc said Thursday its chairman, John Connelly, was approached by a party expressing an interest in buying Connelly's personal land holdings at the Broadwater Beach Resort and Marina in Biloxi, Miss.
A wholly owned subsidiary of the company, President Riverboat Casino-Mississippi Inc, currently conducts gaming operations on a barge at the Broadwater Marina.
The Broadwater site is leased by President Casinos under a long-term lease from Connelly's wholly owned company, BH Acquisition Corp.

President Casinos, which owns and operates riverboat and dockside gaming facilities at various sites, said no definitive proposal has been made, and it is not possible to predict whether any transaction would occur. It said it intends to continue conducting gaming operations indefinitely at the Broadwater location.
